description: This file defines internal API prototypes for the Persistent Storage Manager (PSM) system registry component within the CCSP platform. It includes function declarations for internal operations like interface management, environment setup, configuration import/export, and system memory interactions, but contains no implementation code.

methods.name: PsmSysroGetPsmSseIf
methods.description: Retrieves the PSM SSE interface handle.

methods.name: PsmSysroSetPsmSseIf
methods.description: Sets the PSM SSE interface handle.

methods.name: PsmSysroGetPsmFileLoader
methods.description: Retrieves the file loader handle.

methods.name: PsmSysroGetSysInfoRepository
methods.description: Retrieves the system info repository handle.

methods.name: PsmSysroGetProperty
methods.description: Gets a property from the system registry.

methods.name: PsmSysroSetProperty
methods.description: Sets a property in the system registry.

methods.name: PsmSysroResetProperty
methods.description: Resets properties to default state.

methods.name: PsmSysroEngage
methods.description: Engages or activates the system registry.

methods.name: PsmSysroCancel
methods.description: Cancels or deactivates the system registry operations.

methods.name: PsmSysroRegTimerInvoke
methods.description: Invokes the registry timer callback.

methods.name: PsmSysroSetupEnv
methods.description: Sets up the environment for PSM system registry.

methods.name: PsmSysroCloseEnv
methods.description: Closes or cleans up the environment.

methods.name: PsmSysroResetToFactoryDefault
methods.description: Resets the system registry to factory defaults.

methods.name: PsmSysroImportConfig
methods.description: Imports configuration data into system registry.

methods.name: PsmSysroExportConfig
methods.description: Exports configuration data from system registry.

methods.name: PsmSysroGetConfigSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of the current configuration.

methods.name: PsmSysroSaveConfigToFlash
methods.description: Saves current configuration to flash memory.

methods.name: PsmSysroCfmReadCurConfig
methods.description: Reads current configuration via CFM interface.

methods.name: PsmSysroCfmReadDefConfig
methods.description: Reads default configuration via CFM interface.

methods.name: PsmSysroCfmSaveCurConfig
methods.description: Saves the current configuration via CFM interface.

methods.name: PsmSysroSysRamEnableFileSync
methods.description: Enables or disables file sync in system RAM.

methods.name: PsmSysroSysRamNotify
methods.description: Notifies system RAM of events related to system repository folder.
